Metadata.Title: Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled
Metadata.Name: Online: 15 network updates per second
Metadata.Note: The game sends each player's race state when a timer passes 1/15 s and then resets the timer to 0, so at 60 FPS a send waits 4 or 5 frames: 13.3 updates a second, and weapon events wait for the next one. This sets the timer to 0.06 s: a send every 4 frames at 60 FPS, 15 a second. It changes what this PC sends; everyone in the room should use the same one. Turn on only one of the network-rate patches.
Metadata.Author: haglazpl (OCTR-NitroFueled-PC fork)
